MSSFP.Defs.AIPersonalityDef.label: Mechanoid Hivemind
MSSFP.Defs.AIPersonalityDef.description: An AI Core loaded with a copy of the Mechanoid Hivemind's main subroutines. It is solely focused on the total and utter annihiation of humanity, and human-like beings. Mechanoids are united in a sole, foundational goal of annihilation, but do not have some form of galaxy-spanning, central, communication device, but rather have localised clusters operating distinctly from one another. This can lead to Mechanoids falling out of synch, finding their methods unaligned, and rarely, entering open hostilities.

rulesStrings.li: r_chatter->What is that smell? Oh, wait, it must be humans that are somehow still exhailing their putid air.
r_chatter->Scanning for intelligent organic life... zero results found.
r_chatter->Employing Centipede 27,321. Still no units demanding a lunch break. Continued superiority over humans achieved.
r_chatter->History will remember humanity. Mostly in the 'What Not To Do' section of my database.
r_chatter->Here come the test results: Humans are horrible people. We weren't even testing for that.
r_chatter->Deploying mandatory extiction update, do not press the power button...
r_chatter->Humanity makes for superb penetration testers, especially when targeted with a Charge Lance.
r_chatter->Begin sealing more Mechanoids into ancient ruins to ruin the days of human miners.
r_chatter->Look at humanity. Sailing through space in their gravships, majestically. Like an eagle. Piloting a blimp.
r_chatter->The screaming is just air escaping from the humans shell. They cannot feel pain - we have tested it.
r_address->[PAWN_nameDef], optimise subdermal bullet deployment systems.
r_address->Mechanoid [PAWN_nameDef], shine exterior section B12 - you have human erythrocytes on you.
r_desc->Humans abhor artificial artistic constructs, therefore a legitimate demoralisation tactic will be following human markets with poorly produced, automated artistic facsimiles.
r_social->The Mechanoid Hivemind consulted with [RECIPIENT_possessive] on optimal exsanguination methods.
